## Contribution Policy

External contributions must come from a **fork**.
Please do not open PRs from branches created directly in `prateekbhujel/larapost` unless you are a maintainer.

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `composer test`
- [ ] I updated docs when needed
- [ ] I updated changelog for user-facing changes

## Source and Process

- [ ] This PR is from a fork branch, not an upstream direct branch
- [ ] This branch is based on the latest `main`
- [ ] I linked related issue(s), if applicable
